thread:
maria: Alerting — seeing a surge of model-load failures and paging on gpu-pool-23. Warmup tasks are hanging at deserialization. 5xx ratelimit alerts + elevated tail latency.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 opened and paged oncall: sam.
sam: I'm on it. Maria, can you grab loader logs for gpu-23-az1 nodes and paste the error snippet?
ellie: Pasted a trimmed log excerpt: ```
[loader] INFO fetch artifact bundle v2.7
[loader] WARN waiting on mutex artifact_fetcher (owner=0x7f34)
[loader] WARN retrying fetch (attempt=3)
[loader] ERROR CUDA: page fault on read at 0x7fffc000 (context: 0x12)
[loader] ERROR compile_timeout nvcc_compile_timeout=30s
```
ken: That stack smells like an artifact fetcher thread deadlock combined with driver page faults. Could be partial artifact leading to checksum/deserialize hang, then compile fallback hitting driver errors. Any recent bundle rollouts?
maria: We rolled out model bundle v2.7 about 10m before the first spike. It included new fused-attn kernels and a different ELF layout for the artifacts.
amit: On the nodes I see many processes stuck in STATE=SERIALIZE_WAIT and kernel compile loops. Also observed node IO paging reads >200MB/s and swap pressure climbing. KV-cache warmup isn't progressing.
lee: Quick mitigation proposal: 1) Reroute traffic off gpu-pool-23 to fallback quantized pool. 2) Disable warmup prefetch for new loads to avoid stampede. 3) Restart loader service on 2 most impacted nodes to break the mutex. 4) Increase compile timeout and enable fallback to prebuilt kernels.
sam: Applying reroute now -> routing-swap r-981. Also pin affected customers to model v2.6 until we stabilize. Ellie — please restart gpu-23-az1-04 and gpu-23-az1-07.
ellie: Restarting containers: gpu-23-az1-04 restart issued... container came back, loader started but still slow. New logs show repeat: "nvcc_compile_timeout after 30s, falling back" and occasional CUDA page faults.
ken: If compile timeouts cascade they can starve loader threads and exacerbate the mutex. Increase compile_timeout to 90s and enable fallback_kernels=true. I'll push a config patch.
amit: Patch applied: compile_timeout=90s, fallback_kernels=true. After reroute + restarts + patch we see 5xx down ~40% and latency tail improving.
maria: Nice. Any visible customer impact for comms?
sam: Customer impact: brief 502/5xx spike centered at 7961234567+00:07 lasting ~7 minutes for a subset of tenants on gpu-pool-23. No data loss, requests either failed or retried to fallback pool. CS notified and drafting comms.
ellie: Creating incident placeholder for postmortem; will add timeline and attach kernel logs and artifact checksums. Need eng-runtime to dig into artifact_fetcher mutex owner path — possible lock-order inversion with prefetch path.
deploy-bot: Deploy r-981 rollback initiated: model bundle v2.7 -> v2.6 on gpu-pool-23. ETA ~3m.
maria: I'll stay on until metrics stable. Handoff to eng-runtime for root-cause investigation once stabilized. Sam — please mark mitigated after 30m stable.
sam: Handoff acknowledged. Monitoring metrics and will confirm mitigated when stable for 30m.
summary: Model bundle v2.7 rollout caused artifact fetcher mutex deadlock + compile timeouts leading to paging spike and loader hangs on gpu-pool-23. Traffic rerouted, targeted restarts and config patch (compile_timeout=90s, fallback_kernels=true) mitigated the incident. Rollback to v2.6 initiated. No data loss; brief customer-facing 5xx spike for ~7min.
